lore.ghoul: It still wears its burial ring. It does not remember whose hand it was.
lore.cultist: The Ash Cult prays to rot. Their hymns are mostly coughing.
lore.bone_hound: Hounds of the old kennels, rebuilt by someone who never saw a dog.
lore.rotting_bishop: He blessed the town once. Now his candles burn with grave-fat and his sermons never end.
lore.wick_mother: She dips the road's dead in tallow and sets them burning so travellers can see. She means it kindly.
lore.drowned_abbot: He led the morning mass the day the sea came in. He has not noticed it is over.
lore.slag_saint: The cult poured him while he still breathed, so he would be a saint forever. He is still trying to finish the prayer.
lore.tithe_taker: He takes one bone from every pilgrim who crosses the Wastes. Nobody has ever asked for one back.
lore.ash_jackal: It follows a caravan for days. It can afford to be patient: the desert is on its side.
lore.salt_mummy: The salt kept the body. It did not keep the person.
lore.cinder_scarab: It rolls the ashes of the dead into little balls and buries them, like eggs.
lore.dune_wraith: A traveller who died of thirst one step from the well. It is still reaching for the water.
lore.glass_sentinel: Sand, fused into a soldier by the heat of a falling god. Light bends wrong around it.
lore.glass_pilgrim: He walked into the fallen sun to ask it why. It answered by turning him to glass. He has carried the answer ever since.
lore.plague_rat: One rat is a nuisance. The cart full of them is a funeral.
lore.weeping_nun: Her tears are holy water gone black. She weeps for you, too.
lore.grave_knight: He kept his oath past death. Nobody told him the king is dust.
lore.bone_colossus: A hundred graves, stacked into one walking grudge.
lore.dire_wolf: Ash in its fur, hunger in its eyes. The packs grew bold when the dice broke.
lore.wild_boar: Tusks like plough-blades. Marla wants its hide for blankets.
lore.marsh_serpent: It sleeps under the bells of drowned chapels and wakes when they ring.
lore.giant_spider: Its silk is strong enough to hold a man. It has tested this.
lore.cave_bear: Old as the forest. It does not hate you. It simply does not move aside.
lore.frost_wolf: Its breath freezes the snow mid-fall. Its howl freezes the rest.
lore.sand_crab: It wears the helmets of drowned sailors as a shell.
lore.lava_lizard: It basks in fire the way a cat basks in sun, and bites the same way.
lore.bone_vulture: It waits. In the Bonewastes, waiting always pays.
lore.ashen_alpha: The first wolf to taste the curse. The pack still follows its scent.
lore.bog_mother: She mothers every drowned thing in Veyl. She wants to mother you.
lore.thornback: The forest's last guardian, grown over with briars and grief.
lore.tidecrusher: The tide brings it back every year, a little bigger, a little angrier.
lore.pale_matriarch: Queen of the frost packs. Her fur is white because it has never been touched.
lore.cinder_drake: The cult calls it the mountain's child. It calls the cult breakfast.
